excluded.test: stateUtils.ts formatInitialTransition: Initial state node not found
excluded.reason: XState computes a node's initial transition lazily and throws only when the machine starts; xstate refuses the config at creation (doc: #differences-refused). Measured on XState 5.33.2: with "initial": "nope" a case's expect_create_error fails because XState creates the machine, and its start step throws 'Initial state node "nope" not found on parent state node #m' out of getInitialSnapshot. A case would need a form that expects the refusal at creation on xstate and at start on XState. The refusal rows of test/xstate/machine_test.cpp cover xstate's side.
